title: Named values
summary: PHP: Named values. Change pencils to 6 and predict the sum.
introduction: A variable keeps a value under a name. PHP variable names start with a dollar sign.
learningObjectives: Change pencils to 6 and predict the sum

blocks.text: Install PHP 8.2 or later. Save each example as lesson.php and run php lesson.php. These are local programs, not a server for this learning site.
$pencils stores 3. The addition produces 5 before echo displays it.
Change pencils to 6 and predict the sum.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use $pencils every time you read that variable.
